summary: Transparency reports have no id field and are identified by their period, so the store keys them on the composite year-halfYearId and the local resolver reconstructs that id from the /{year}/{halfYearId} path segments.
reason: The generic id extractors find no id/uuid on report payloads, so cached reports either skipped the store or collided under one static id, breaking offline period lookups.
validated_outcome: A live read of /api/transparency/2025/1 caches under id 2025-1 and --data-source local returns the same report afterward.
